name: postman
description: Work with Postman from your agent: bootstrap a repo's Postman setup, mock an API before it's implemented, run collection and governance checks in CI, monitor a live endpoint, deploy and debug Postman Flows, and publish generated API documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, mock, test, monitor, document, and automate APIs with Postman.
interface.longDescription: Postman's skills for coding agents. Bootstrap a repository's Postman setup, mock an API before it's implemented, run collection and governance checks in CI, monitor a deployed endpoint, deploy and debug Postman Flows, and publish generated API documentation — driven through the Postman CLI, with the Postman MCP server bundled for the parts that have no CLI surface.
defaultPrompt: Set up Postman in this repo.
Mock this API so the frontend can start.
Add Postman contract checks to CI.
